dedupe_keys.name: 3d basisvoorziening nationwide 3d buildings and terrain of the netherlands kadaster

description: The 3D Basisvoorziening is Kadaster's nationwide collection of three-dimensional spatial data of the Netherlands, intended to make up-to-date 3D topography available uniformly for government processes. The product description read on 2026-09-28 (version of 22 September 2026) lists eight collections usable at scales between 1:500 and 1:10,000, generated from the large-scale topography of the BGT, the buildings of the BAG, heights from the AHN (editions 4, 5 and 6) and point clouds from aerial imagery: buildings modelled in LoD 2.2 (LoD 1.3 where no AHN data exist), terrain including roads and water, and derived products. Data are offered as OGC 3D Tiles for visualisation (latest edition only), CityJSON, GeoPackage, Quantized Mesh and LAZ point clouds, with a separate download instruction; coverage is national with yearly editions. Access is free through Kadaster's 3D portal; the licence is not stated in the description read, although Kadaster base registrations are generally open. Caveats: building heights from aerial imagery are less accurate than LiDAR, collections differ in edition year, and the 3D Tiles are for viewing, not analysis. It supports hazard exposure analysis (flooding, heat, wind), digital twins and climate adaptation studies of Dutch buildings and public space. Related records: data-3dbag is the TU Delft 3D building model and data-bag-netherlands the building registry both build on.
